assumptions.assumption: Front‑gap (±30°) detection is sufficient to trigger stop for any moving obstacle
assumptions.why: Side movers caused collisions despite being within 0.6 m of the robot (runs c51t30_s1084981817, c51t30_s275133499)

assumptions.assumption: Free‑heading based on current lidar points and short‑term predictions avoids all collisions
assumptions.why: Collision with static box (run c51t30_s193767252) shows chosen free sector intersected a known obstacle

assumptions.assumption: TTC window of 1 s (_TTC_H) and margin _SAFE=0.25 m are enough for safe motion
assumptions.why: Collisions occurred while TTC was >1 s (side movers approached from the side and were not slowed early enough)

assumptions.assumption: Stopping only when front gap < _STOP_D and waiting _STOP_WAIT seconds before detour yields efficient progress
assumptions.why: Long stop‑turn episodes (58 in the pass run) inflate execution time; reducing wait time is needed

assumptions.assumption: Static waypoint following without dynamic replanning is adequate when obstacles are avoided by stop/detour
assumptions.why: When collisions are prevented, the robot reaches the goal using the existing waypoint logic

diagnosis.chosen: Add a TTC‑based speed‑scaling factor and shorten stop/detour timing to prevent side‑approaching collisions and eliminate time‑limit failures.
diagnosis.direction: 1. Define a new function _min_ttc(pose, movers) after _min_mover_dist that loops over movers, computes dx, dy, dvx, dvy as in _is_safe, clamps each TTC to [0,_TTC_H] and returns the smallest value (or _TTC_H if no movers). 2. In controller(), after calling _movers(t, pose) and before computing f, call ttc = _min_ttc(pose, movers). 3. Compute f_ttc = _clamp(ttc / _TTC_H, 0.15, 1.0) and combine with the existing front‑gap factor: f = min(f, f_ttc). 4. Use this combined f for all scaled commands (v_nom * f * k) and for the resume check (gap >= _GO_D and _is_safe(pose, (v_nom * f, w_nom), movers, _SAFE_GO)). 5. Change constants: set _STOP_WAIT = 0.5, _DETOUR_T = 3.0, _DETOUR_ROT = 0.6 to reduce idle waiting and detour duration. 6. Keep all other logic unchanged.
diagnosis.last_direction_ok: no – turn 30 reduced pass rate from 50 % (turn 29) to 25 % and more than doubled the average execution time, indicating the last change worsened both safety and speed

stage1.target: controller function (speed‑factor computation) and addition of a _min_ttc helper; also update constants _STOP_WAIT, _DETOUR_T, _DETOUR_ROT.
stage1.direction: 1. Add a new function _min_ttc(pose, movers) after _min_mover_dist that returns the smallest TTC (clamped to [_TTC_H,0]). 2. In controller(), after calling _movers(), compute d_min = _min_mover_dist(pose, movers) and ttc = _min_ttc(pose, movers). 3. Compute f_front = 1.0 if gap>=2.5 else _clamp((gap-_STOP_D)/1.5,0.15,1.0); f_side = _clamp((d_min-_STOP_D)/1.5,0.15,1.0); f_ttc = _clamp(ttc/_TTC_H,0.15,1.0); then set f = min(f_front, f_side, f_ttc). 4. Pass f to _plan_cmd as before so both pc and candidate scaling respect the combined factor. 5. Change constants to _STOP_WAIT=1.0, _DETOUR_T=4.0, _DETOUR_ROT=0.8 to shorten idle periods. 6. Keep all existing state‑machine logic unchanged.
